implementation: Shared responsive stylesheet and mobile header, accessible drawer and FAQ controls, responsive page-family styles, and regeneration integration.

notes: The audit accounts for the left scrollbar origin in right-to-left documents; all 72 initially flagged scrollbar-offset cases were rechecked at 320 pixels.
Redirect shells and the embedded sponsor frame are covered by static integration rather than standalone rendering.
Empty third-party advertising click layers are excluded from visible-content overflow measurements.

browserInteractions: Phone navigation opens, expands console sections, closes, restores focus and unlocks scrolling.
Home section links update focus and the URL fragment; game search filters results.
FAQ answers expand fully; unmatched searches show an accessible empty state.
Arabic header controls do not overlap and the document does not overflow horizontally.
Desktop sidebar collapse and expansion work; crossing the 1024-pixel breakpoint restores the saved desktop state.
Phone image preview opens and closes, with a 48-pixel close target and an image contained within the viewport.
environment: Local Chromium browser preview; no physical phone or console execution, downloads, or deployment performed.
